case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You asked us to look at your offer against labour and material costs, and our options answer that with a longer horizon: each one is a multi-year agreement for both family companies, which is the kind of arrangement your firm has said it prefers.

On quality:
Your quality was 302 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives you a longer contract term while the quality record above supports a price at this level. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

In plain words, Option A gives your firm a binding contract for a long term on a standard bearing, so your capacity is planned well ahead, with a reliable family customer who pays on the agreed due date.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

We would be glad to settle this together, as one family company with another.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Please understand that as a matter of policy, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We welcome the prospect of a 24-month agreement and are willing to accept the 45-day payment terms you proposed in Option A. To reflect the extended contract duration and payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €4.90 per unit.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €4.90 per unit. As an alternative package, we offer a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Both help us find a fair solution for our two family companies.

You said that material is the heart of your cost. We understand that, and these options are built around the kind of multi-year agreement your firm has told us it prefers: a longer horizon for your planning and a firm basis for both sides.

Option A is the package we can approve.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.62; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As you may need to take this further, here is a short paragraph for your decision-maker. Option A gives Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd a binding multi-year agreement with a reliable family customer, clear planning for its capacity over the whole term, and payment on the agreed due date. It can be approved as it stands.

Could you please take Option A to the person who decides and let us know the outcome?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer and your preference for a 24-month agreement. 

It is always our pleasure to serve you from our extensive range with the reliable service you expect from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please provide the data underlying your target price, as it does not align with our material costs. We can adjust our offer to €4.89 per unit for a 24-month contract with 45-day payment terms. As an alternative, we also offer a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you very much for your continued interest in our products and services. We always value our partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and appreciate your business.

We note that no further data was provided to support your target price. After carefully reviewing your request, this represents our best possible pricing for this package. Our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this is valid for 7 days.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide if you would like to proceed with these conditions, as we would be delighted to continue supplying your requirements with our reliable service and extensive range. 

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
